Word 文档转换：全部可用目标Word conversions: every available target

Word 文档的价值常常在结构里：标题层级、列表、表格。mammoth 把 .docx 还原成语义 HTML，之后每条路线再决定保留哪一部分。分页、页眉页脚与批注属于 Word 的版式层，离开 Word 后基本不保留。Much of a Word document’s value sits in its structure: heading levels, lists, tables. Mammoth turns the .docx back into semantic HTML, and each route then decides which part to keep. Pagination, headers, footers and comments belong to Word’s layout layer and mostly do not survive leaving it.

这个来源格式的共同限制What holds for every target from this source

  • 合并单元格、脚注、批注、修订痕迹与文本框没有稳定的 HTML 对应物，会被降级、合并或丢弃Merged cells, footnotes, comments, tracked changes and text boxes have no stable HTML counterpart, so they are flattened, merged or dropped
  • 页眉、页脚、页码与 Word 自己的分页不进入结果；PDF 与图片路线按浏览器重新排版Headers, footers, page numbers and Word’s own pagination do not enter the result; PDF and image routes reflow in the browser
  • 嵌入的图片来自文档内部，可以保留；链接到外部地址的图片不会下载，按张数披露Images embedded inside the document survive; images linked to an external address are not downloaded and are counted
  • 输出文档的字体、页边距与行距由目标格式决定，不沿用原 .docx 的主题Fonts, margins and line spacing in the output belong to the target format, not to the original .docx theme

常见问题Questions people actually ask

Word 转 PDF 会保留原来的分页吗？Will Word to PDF keep the original pagination?

不会。文档先还原成 HTML，再由浏览器排版并按 A4 切片；分页取决于浏览器对这份 HTML 的排版，不读取 Word 的页面设置。No. The document is rebuilt as HTML and laid out by the browser before being sliced into A4 pages. Pagination follows the browser’s layout of that HTML, not the page setup stored in Word.

批注和修订会被带过去吗？Do comments and tracked changes travel?

不会。它们属于 Word 的审阅层，HTML 没有对应物，转换前就被丢弃。若这些内容重要，先在接受修订、导出批注之后再转。No. They belong to Word’s review layer, which HTML has no counterpart for, and they are dropped before conversion. If they matter, accept the changes and export the comments first.

为什么 Word 转 Excel 只看到表格？Why does Word to Excel show only the tables?

因为 Excel 只有单元格。转换器读取文档里的表格，标题与段落没有坐标可以落。文档没有表格时，它会尝试把一段 JSON 代码读成数组，否则明确报错。Because Excel only has cells. The converter reads the document’s tables, while headings and paragraphs have no coordinates. Without a table it tries a JSON code block, and otherwise fails explicitly.

能批量转换一批 Word 文件吗？Can a batch of Word files be converted together?

能。最多 200 个文件、单个 100 MB；整批共用一个目标格式，每个文件独立走路线，一个失败不会阻断其余文件。结果可以逐个下载或打成一个 ZIP。Yes. Up to 200 files at 100 MB each, one target for the batch, and every file walks the route independently so one failure does not stop the rest. Results download one by one or as a ZIP.

不需要账号，也不需要联网：装好扩展后点图标，在新标签页里打开工作台，文件从磁盘直接选。No account and no network: install the extension, click its icon, and the workbench opens in a new tab reading straight off your disk.
